news.title: Enterprise software control has its blind spots
news.summary: As AI agents integrate into enterprise workflows and deepfakes pose external risks, centralized control models are encountering increasing visibility and oversight challenges within enterprise software. While centralization aims to increase stability for AI and automation, it can inadvertently create blind spots in transparency and governance due to the difficulty in tracing systemic impacts. Therefore, alongside centralization, enterprises must invest in enhanced visibility, robust governance frameworks, and security measures to manage the complexities introduced by accelerated automation and potential impersonation.

news.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is focusing on long-term growth in AI and enterprise solutions. The company recently partnered with CrowdStrike to make its Falcon cybersecurity platform available on Microsoft Marketplace, allowing customers to use Azure Consumption Commitment (ACC) for purchases. Additionally, Microsoft and Ericsson are integrating enterprise 5G management into Windows 11 to simplify the deployment and management of 5G-connected PCs.

news.title: Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft and Nvidia are part of Zacks Earnings Preview
news.summary: Zacks.com previews earnings for Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Nvidia, highlighting concerns about the "Magnificent 7" companies' capital expenditures on AI infrastructure. Nvidia stands out as the true AI bellwether, with projected massive revenue growth. The article also notes the significant earnings power of the Mag 7 group, contributing a substantial portion to the S&P 500's total earnings.

news.title: ROSEN, A LEADING INVESTOR RIGHTS LAW FIRM, Encourages Richtech Robotics Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by The Firm - RR
news.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors of Richtech Robotics Inc. (NASDAQ: RR) who purchased securities between January 27, 2026, and January 29, 2026, about the upcoming April 3, 2026, lead plaintiff deadline in a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Richtech Robotics made false and misleading statements about a collaborative and commercial relationship with Microsoft that did not exist. Investors who suffered damages due to these alleged misrepresentations are encouraged to secure counsel.
